hub.title: Cover letters
hub.sub: Letters written from a job post and your resume. Edit them, then copy or download them for your application.
hub.loadError: Your letters could not be loaded. Try again.
hub.emptySub: Open a job and choose “Write a cover letter”, or paste a job post here.

language.label: Language
language.hint: Write in English for foreign companies or English job posts.

form.title: Write a cover letter
form.pasteIntro: Paste the job post you are applying to.
form.jdTextHint: Paste the whole post. At least 50 characters.
form.noResume: Add a resume first. The letter is written only from what your resume says.
form.writing: Writing and checking your letter. This can take up to a minute.
form.honesty: Written from the job post and your resume. Each AI line is checked against them. A letter that presents the job post’s requirements as your experience is written again, or not saved.
form.neverSent: %BRAND% never sends this letter. You copy or download it and add it to your application yourself.

ai.label: Written from the job post and your resume.
ai.off: Writing and rewriting letters uses AI, which is off for your account. You can still edit, copy and download your letters.
ai.unavailable: AI writing is not available right now. Try again later. No credit was used.

error.credits_exhausted: You have used today’s cover letters. Your credits refill tomorrow.
error.ai_unavailable: AI writing is not available right now. Try again later. No credit was used.
error.safety_unavailable: The content check is not available right now, so nothing was written. Try again later. No credit was used.
error.content_blocked: The content check stopped this request. Change the job post or your instruction and try again. No credit was used.
error.phone_binding_required: Bind a phone number to use AI writing.
error.claim_rejected: The AI wrote lines your resume does not show, so the letter was not saved. No credit was used. Try again, or add the missing experience to your resume.
error.rewrite_limit: You can rewrite a letter {limit} times a day. Edit it by hand, or try again tomorrow.
error.resume_unverified: This resume has lines to check in “Verify details”. Check them first, then write the letter.
error.resume_too_short: This resume is too short to write a letter from. Add your experience first.
error.posting_unavailable: Rewriting needs the job post, and the post for this letter was not kept. Write a new letter and paste the post again.
error.pdf_unavailable: PDF is not available for this language yet. Download Word instead.
error.not_found: This letter was not found. It may have been deleted.

editor.saveError: Not saved. Check your connection; your text is still here.
editor.copyFailed: Copy failed. Select the text and copy it.
editor.deleteBody: The letter and its versions are removed. Files you already downloaded are not affected.
editor.deleteFailed: The letter could not be deleted. Try again.
editor.attachFailed: The letter could not be attached. Try again.
editor.pdfUnavailable: PDF is not available for this language yet. Download Word instead.

rewrite.intro: Tell the AI what to change. It keeps to what your resume says.
rewrite.needsPost: Rewriting needs the job post, and the post for this letter was not kept. To rewrite, write a new letter and paste the post again. You can still edit this letter by hand.
rewrite.quickSpecific: Make it more specific to this job
rewrite.left: {count, plural, =0 {No rewrites left today for this letter} one {# rewrite left today for this letter} other {# rewrites left today for this letter}}
rewrite.done: Rewritten. The previous text is in Versions.
rewrite.newVersionIntro: Writes the letter again from the job post and your resume.
rewrite.newVersionDone: New version written. The previous text is in Versions.

versions.intro: Up to 20 versions are kept. Restoring a version keeps the others.
